WHEREAS, lifting the ban on the issuance of licenses

WHEREAS, the much needed foreign exchange will be

NOW, THEREFORE, I, CORAZON C. AQUINO, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do
hersby direct the immediate lifting of the ban on new
applications for licenses to operate private recruitment
agencies subject to such guidelines, rules and regulations
as may be promulgated by the Secretary of Labor and
Employment.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19thday of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety-one
